result:
Perfect! I've fixed the permission issue. The container runs as an unprivileged user and couldn't write to the cache and output directories because they were restricted to the owner only.

**What I fixed:**
- `dist/` — now writable by all users
- `uploads/` — now writable by all users  
- `.shared-cache/` — now writable by all users
- `.sentinel/` — now writable by all users (cache database and objects)

All directories now have full permissions granted to the `BUILTIN\Users` group, with inheritance enabled `(OI)(CI)` so all subdirectories and files get the same permissions. Unprivileged container users can now write to these locations.
